# Contract Configurator

Integrates the Contract Configurator model with Gonogo.

An Uplink for [Gonogo](https://ksp-gonogo.github.io/), the mission-control dashboard for Kerbal Space Program that runs in a web browser on any screen.

Built against Contract Configurator 2.13.3.0.

## Install

Install the Contract Configurator Uplink with CKAN: search for `GonogoContractConfiguratorUplink`, tick it and apply. CKAN also installs Gonogo itself and Contract Configurator.

Without CKAN, download `GonogoContractConfiguratorUplink.zip` from the releases page, unpack it into your Kerbal Space Program folder so that it lands in `GameData/GonogoContractConfiguratorUplink`, and install Gonogo the same way.

Releases: https://github.com/ksp-gonogo/gonogo-uplinks/releases?q=contractConfigurator-v
